description: Compare two playlists up to the configured source cap: tracks only in A, only in B (by track ID), and tracks present in both but at different positions. Rendered rows are capped by max_results; truncation metadata reports when source walks hit scan_cap.

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate inputs and describe exactly what would change without performing it

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

playlist_a.description: Canonical A playlist; provide with playlist_b

playlist_b.description: Canonical B playlist; provide with playlist_a

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

scan_cap.description: Maximum source rows to scan; bounded by SPOTIFY_MCP_FETCH_ALL_CAP

name: diff_playlists
